bio: I am Radin, an indie video game developer who LOVES retro and arcade video games.

bio: Hello! I’m an indie developer currently living in Bradenton, Florida. More importantly, I’m a husband, father, avid skateboarder, and exclamation point enthusiast! While I created Dexter Stardust and some of the other characters together with my friends Munk Alejandro, Lola Mendez, and Alec Corday, I am a one-man-band behind the scenes;

I do the programming, artwork, game design, music production, sound design, and whatever else needs to be done. I regularly feel like tearing my hair out in frustration, but my wonderful wife always brings me back to reality. She’s the best!

bio: I wrote my first program as a kid in 1982, on my grandmother’s black and white TV, with a Sinclair Spectrum 48K, before moving on to the Commodore 64. It was an amazing experience and from that day on I knew I wanted to make games. I run pixel games, an independent development studio based in Luxembourg, focused on creating fun, classic, arcade experiences for modern machines.
name: Sebastian, Pixel Games
query: Sebastian, Pixel Games Donut Dodo, Cash Cow DX
summary: Classic arcade experiences from an independent Luxembourg studio.

bio: I’m Xavi, a.k.a hiulit, an indie developer based in Barcelona. I like creating fun arcade games that could have been released in the 80’s. I grew up playing mostly Nintendo consoles, so it’s a dream come true to have my games on the Switch.

bio: Andrea Demetrio is an Italian solo developer with a PhD in Physics (don’t ask). Mostly known for his 3D fighting game Schwarzerblitz and defined as a «trolling creator» by some players due to his approach to game development, he routinely explores different genres depending on how inspiration strikes him. He started his (so far) one man studio «Der Mondhase» in 2021. 8-Colors Star Guardians + is his first commercial game and the first to be published on console.
name: Andrea, Der Mondhase
summary: Italian solo developer and founder of Der Mondhase.

bio: Hello! bio: Hello! I’m David and I’m a solo indie developer from Quebec City, Canada. I like to create neo-retro arcade games just like what I used to play growing up in the 90’s. I keep things short and simple and as a speedrunner myself, I really enjoy adding a twist where you’re rewarded for completing my games as fast as possible. With Vidvad Games, I do the programming, pixel art and game design, and I partner up with a good friend of mine (ZerolagGaming) for the music. I wish I could tell my younger self that one day, one of my creation would run on a Nintendo console. What a surreal experience!
name: David Langlois, Vidvad Games

summary: Quebec-based creator of neo-retro arcade games and speedrunning.

bio: I’m Luke Orsie, animator/artist for crashable studios. Besides making games I enjoy skateboarding, fishing, firearms, Dogs, cats, bush-crafting, and most non-traditional sports. Crashable Studios is comprised of us two brothers, Luke (me) and Micah. We have been gamers since we were kids in the 90’s. I remember firing up «Contra» on our brand new NES we got for Christmas in that time. Those memories and gaming moments have stuck with us through the years and we strive to recreated those magic moments/feelings we get from gaming in our own creative way. We have been developing since 2012 when our first game «Alum» was kickstarted and are on our third commercial title as of the writing of this bio.
name: Luke Orsie, Crashable Studios
query: Luke Orsie, Crashable Studios Sentry City
summary: Two brothers drawing inspiration from their 1990s gaming.

bio: My name is Enzo Brown and I’m a solo-developer that makes Yesterday’s Games, Today. I’ve made art all my life and I’ve made (or at least tried to make) games since the flash days. It wasn’t until 2023 that I decided to give game-development a real shot. There’s something about older titles that really draws me in and it is my goal to try and capture that magic in my projects.

bio: I’m Magnus Fredriksson, animator, filmmaker, and now indie game developer, thanks to a mild midlife crisis.
